summary: Short, steep kerb on a cul-de-sac bend with homes 13 m away.

best_section.where: Mavis Street cul-de-sac bend, south side

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 13-17 m away, ringed by houses all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a few cars parked; 16 m of kerb barely fits a van.
drivers.convention: Residents park along the kerb; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade the east side in the morning.
